answer: Keep your car insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, then cancel your policy or remove the car from it only after you sign the paperwork, and ask your insurer about a refund for any unused premium. If your plates were issued by North Carolina, leave them on the car, since North Carolina plates stay with the vehicle (what you do depends on the state that issued the plates, not where you live). Before handover, remove toll tags and parking stickers, clear garage door codes, and unpair your phone from the car's system. If the car has a connected-car app, also remove the car from your account so the next owner can't see your data.
